body:
Already done on `upstream/main` `31f8d03d` at the `v0.21.0` cut (PR #1936, `d1db419f`).

Both named heavy lanes ran in the `v0.21.0` release gate on the Linux cut runner:

- `app heavy: stock_engine_agreement` passed in both cut gate runs (`43739171721` in 22.34s and `43746559176` in 22.32s; 3 passed, 0 failed). No counts changed.
- `motion heavy: pocket3d_hsm` passed in both runs (`43739171721` in 9.23s and `43746559176` in 9.30s; 1 passed, 0 failed).
- `app heavy: pocket3d_hsm` (`the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`) failed in run `43739171721` (47.07s) at `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs:99` because the wide stock ring from PR #1780 hit the HSM planner budgets.
- That red lane got its own issue (#1950, active in PR #2035).
- Commit `bf752be6` in PR #1936 set `Containment::Inside` on the `user_job` fixture in `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs` to keep testing the bore silhouette. No pinned per-OS count changed (`(16017, 15360, 1427)` on Windows x86_64 release per `bf752be6`; `(16029, 15372, 1427)` passed on Linux x86_64 in run `43746559176`; macOS did not run on the Linux cut runner).
- Run `43746559176` at `bf752be6` passed `app heavy: pocket3d_hsm` (5.30s; 1 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored) and all 187 release-gate steps.
- `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs` and `crates/app/tests/stock_engine_agreement.rs` are unchanged between `v0.21.0` (`d1db419f`) and `upstream/main` (`31f8d03d`).

Suggest closing; the maintainer decides.

Already done on upstream/main af83da0f at the v0.21.0 cut (PR #1936).

I checked release run 43746559176 at bf752be6. Its log confirms these results:
- motion heavy: pocket3d_hsm passed.
- app heavy: pocket3d_hsm passed.
- app heavy: stock_engine_agreement passed.
- All 187 gate steps passed.

Commit bf752be6 explains the bore fixture change after PR #1780. Issue #1950 tracks the whole-model stock ring failure.

The GitHub comparison from v0.21.0 to af83da0f shows no changes to either named app test file.

Evidence: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43746559176

I did not claim this issue or change code. Suggest closing; the maintainer decides.
